replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, bring the equation to standard form ax² + bx + c = 0. Then check the discriminant b² - 4ac to see how many roots exist. Use the quadratic formula x = (-b ± sqrt(b²-4ac)) / (2a) to find them.

Take the derivative of the function, then set it equal to zero and solve for x. Those x-values are where the stationary points occur. Plug them back into the original function to get the corresponding y-coordinates.
